editorNote: Figma is the center of a quiet week: it described how it is training an editing model that understands Figma files, and it detailed Weave for repeatable creative workflows. The other thread is governance. Nielsen Norman Group asks where UX fits in agent-built software, and two design-systems pieces argue generated screens need brand rules and a feedback loop to stay on system.
